newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - Dec 19.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - Dec 19.

text.p: Prepared for Reuters by The Broadcast Monitoring Company

Prince Philip made a controversial attack on the handgun ban in the wake of the Dunblane massacre. The comments brought outrage from MPs who criticised the Duke as "crass" and "insensitive". Graham Downing of the British Shooting Sports Council countered, "The emphasis in firearms control must be on the individual and not the gun."

Oftel is set to clamp down on anti-competitive behaviour in the digital television market. The move would prevent companies like BSkyB controlling vital technology. If a company breached the rules the watchdog could seek a court injunction. The Oftel head Don Cruikshank commented, "The aim is to ensure the best deal for the customer".
RANK GROUP POISED TO WEED OUT PLANTATION

Rank Group is set to announce the sale of real estate business Kingston Plantation as part of its disposal programme. The move was part of the initiative to simplify Rank into four core businesses. The news could add some value to the lacklustre share price performance.
Sterling maintained its heights as traders bet the Bundesbank would leave rates unchanged. The pound was buoyed by a rising dollar, a sharp fall in British unemployment and strong retail sales data.
